provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre / Eurostat

request_contract.parameter_rules: Exact catalogue-linked ZIP path only. Documentation-only; no live request, automated retrieval, archive expansion or bulk acquisition authorized. Review exact source version and acquisition terms before any bounded HEAD or Range canary.

response_contract.format: Publisher catalogue describes GeoTIFF raster distribution; exact download link ends in ZIP. Archive member names, byte length, checksum, CRS, NoData and data type are not yet independently verified.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: 100 m estimated resident population derived from Census V2-0 (2024-06-16), not V3. Disaggregation uses residential built-up volume and shared EUBUCCO, Overture, GHSL and TomTom inputs. Not independent footprint evidence or surveyed individual exposure. Validate 1 km aggregate conservation against exact V2-0, mask and pixel semantics before any CAT consumer.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Catalogue declares anonymous access without registration. Separate service automation and rate constraints remain unreviewed; zero original-byte requests authorized. A binary link was identified from public catalogue metadata, not a successful source download.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Catalogue revision and DOI identify the product, not an immutable ZIP digest. Future source receipt must pin exact URL, response size, retrieval time, SHA-256, archive members and native raster profile before scientific comparison.

rights_and_policy.notes: Catalogue declares European Commission reuse subject to attribution and excludes third-party intellectual property. Review upstream input rights and exact derivative scope; anonymous access does not independently establish commercial automation, raw redistribution or model admission.

notes: Catalogue metadata and exact linked ZIP route reviewed on 2026-11-27. No original ZIP body, checksum, pixel sample, insurer data, or model admission. The web reader could not process the ZIP response; do not infer availability of a complete valid archive from this observation.
